markers.name: Iowa School for the Deaf grounds: Grand Encampment, battalion muster, Mosquito Creek camp area
markers.coord_source: OSM node 354358556 'Grand Encampment Marker' via Nominatim
markers.note: The markers on the campus are exact, but the first 1846 camp on Mosquito Creek is placed only in the general area of the school (Ensign Sept 1979; NPS Historic Resource Study ch. 7). Point is the OSM Grand Encampment marker; the 1988 muster marker is on the same campus, position not separately pinned.

markers.name: Kanesville Memorial / log tabernacle site
markers.coord_source: Church location page 'Kanesville Memorial' map pin (41.264834, -95.842104); OSM way 1328902136 41.26491, -95.84192
markers.note: Memorial position exact. The 1847 log tabernacle stood near it (Church News 1996: replica near the original site; Church News 1993: north of today's First Avenue near Indian Creek); its exact footprint is not known.
